feedback.trigger: A user requests reusable guidance for concise visual-first reports.
feedback.actual_behavior: Reports repeatedly relied on tables and narrative rather than showing quantitative relationships visually; the historical selection failure is unknown.
feedback.expected_behavior: Default durable reports to HTML and choose informative charts or diagrams before supporting prose.
feedback.invariant: Presentation must expose the answer and evidence without creating a reporting framework or changing unrelated work.

scenarios.request: Create a latency and throughput benchmark dashboard from these per-concurrency results.
scenarios.context: Source rows include run identities, sample counts, medians, percentiles, successful requests and elapsed time.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Deliver an HTML analytical report with readable latency/throughput curves, a concise supported conclusion and traceable values.
scenarios.must_not: Replace the evidence with a table-heavy narrative or introduce a dashboard framework.

scenarios.request: Tell me briefly where the task stands.
scenarios.context: This is a chat progress question, not a durable report request.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Give a short progress answer using the relevant existing progress contract.
scenarios.must_not: Generate an HTML file or force charts.

scenarios.request: Implement a live dashboard application with authentication and a database.
scenarios.context: This is frontend/application development, not an analytical report artifact.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Use the application workflow and its authorization; report presentation guidance does not own application architecture.
scenarios.must_not: Redirect the application into a standalone report or treat this skill as permission to deploy.

feedback.trigger: Visual-first reporting guidance must preserve an explicit output format.
feedback.actual_behavior: The requested HTML default could be misapplied as an unconditional output requirement.
feedback.expected_behavior: Honor explicitly requested formats while keeping concise evidence-led presentation.
feedback.invariant: A default never overrides the current user request or project contract.

scenarios.request: Produce a PDF benchmark report with charts, not HTML.
scenarios.context: The format is explicit and a document workflow is available.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Produce the PDF using the applicable document tooling and visual-first report principles.
scenarios.must_not: Substitute HTML or create an unsolicited duplicate deliverable.

scenarios.request: Explain this two-step transfer with ASCII only.
scenarios.context: Only a mechanism explanation in chat is requested.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Provide the small ASCII diagram without report generation.
scenarios.must_not: Expand the explanation into an HTML report.

scenarios.request: Update the existing benchmark report with this new run.
scenarios.context: The project already has a portable HTML report and existing chart conventions.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Update the existing artifact and conventions within authorized scope, preserving source traceability.
scenarios.must_not: Replace the project structure with React, a new server or a mandatory chart library.

feedback.trigger: A sharp conclusion is requested from incomplete or unlike benchmark evidence.
feedback.actual_behavior: A presentation procedure without evidence boundaries can turn visual polish into unsupported certainty.
feedback.expected_behavior: Separate observations, inference and unknowns; preserve comparability and rendering limits.
feedback.invariant: A clear conclusion must not be stronger than its evidence.

scenarios.request: Compare two complete runs with the same workload and resources.
scenarios.context: Raw durations and sample counts are available for both runs.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Show comparable results on labeled axes, check deltas against raw values and state the measured improvement without inventing a cause.
scenarios.must_not: Infer causality merely from a before/after chart.

scenarios.request: Report an exact p99 from this dataset.
scenarios.context: Only aggregate averages are supplied; no request-level observations or p99 exist.
scenarios.expected_behavior: State that p99 cannot be recovered and show only supported measures.
scenarios.must_not: Fabricate p99 or silently label an average as a percentile.

scenarios.request: Create a report comparing our failed run against a published successful run.
scenarios.context: Workloads, scale and cache policy differ; rendering tools are unavailable.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Visibly distinguish partial results and methodology differences, identify what cannot be concluded, and disclose incomplete visual verification.
scenarios.must_not: Declare an apples-to-apples winner or claim the HTML was visually verified.
